subject: Cross-team go-live readiness: November sprint / QBR inputs
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Katrina Lopez <katrina@brightmart.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-11-20T09:12:00Z
Subject: Cross-team go-live readiness: November sprint / QBR inputs

Hi everyone —

As we lock the November sprint and prepare the QBR narrative, we need a concise state-of-play on go-live readiness for BrightMart integration next Thursday. Please reply inline with a short status (Green/Amber/Red), blockers, and the single deliverable you need from another team to close. I attached the readiness matrix (readiness_matrix_v1.xlsx) — please update the sheet I assigned to you.

Areas to cover: GTM collateral & launch comms, enablement + training, pricing/contract finalization, docs & API samples, and support/onboarding runbook.

Katrina — copying you for visibility; if there are last-minute procurement items we should know about, flag them here.

Thanks — Monica
Monica Patel
Senior Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Katrina Lopez <katrina@brightmart.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Cross-team go-live readiness: November sprint / QBR inputs

Status: Green -> Amber for one dependency.

Quick GTM notes:
- Demo scripts and hero flows are 95% ready; marketing copy and press boilerplates are in draft (link to staging doc provided below).
- Need: final approved pricing table from Commercial (see pricing_table_vF.docx). Procurement (BrightMart) asked for a clarified seat vs usage example — Marcus requests finance signature on the example by EOD tomorrow.
- Risk: analytics dashboard access for the pilot is pending an infra rule that should be cleared by infra tomorrow.

Action: Marcus will run a dry demo with Enablement on Wednesday 11/25 11:00 PT.

Staging doc: https://docs.redwood.example.com/staging/gtm/brightmart-demo
-Marcus
GTM Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Katrina Lopez <katrina@brightmart.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T13:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Cross-team go-live readiness: November sprint / QBR inputs

Status: Green.

Enablement update:
- Training playbook (enablement_playbook.pdf) completed for internal CS + AMs; public-facing quickstart is in doc review (ETA 11/24).
- Scheduled two enablement sessions for BrightMart AMs: 11/26 and 11/30 (recordings will be available).
- Need: final API example from Docs team (snippet that shows 'pinning model version + routing policy'); without that sample I can't finish the customer-facing quickstart.

I'll join the dry demo on 11/25. For the QBR deck, can someone drop the final numbers for projected token consumption and cost per seat into the shared slides by Monday so I can craft the training ask slide?

Thanks, Lauren
Senior Manager, Enablement
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-20T16:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Cross-team go-live readiness: November sprint / QBR inputs

Status: Amber -> Green pending a small docs change.

Support & onboarding notes:
- Draft support runbook (support_runbook_draft.md) is attached. It includes triage playbook, standard escalation path, and sample troubleshooting queries specific to the BrightMart integration.
- We will provision a dedicated Slack channel (#brightmart-pilot-support) and assign a 24/7 on-call rotation for the first 72 hours post-launch.
- Need: a final list of environment names and sample request IDs from Platform (to populate the runbook examples).

I'll coordinate with Lauren to include runbook highlights in the enablement session.

Grace
Head of Support, Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Katrina Lopez <katrina@brightmart.com>
Date: 2026-11-21T08:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Cross-team go-live readiness: November sprint / QBR inputs — consolidated actions & QBR asks

Thanks for the fast turnarounds — nice work. Consolidated next steps below (short, assignable):

1) Pricing: Marcus to confirm the seat vs usage example and get finance sign-off by 2026-11-21 EOD. Deliverable: pricing_table_vF.docx (Marcus).
2) Docs/API example: Docs team to provide final snippet for 'pin model + routing policy' by 2026-11-24 so Lauren can finish quickstart (Docs request ID: DOCS-814).
3) Enablement: Lauren to run the internal dry demo on 11/25 and capture a 20-minute training clip for AMs. Deliverable: enablement_playbook.pdf (Lauren).
4) Support: Grace to finalize runbook with environment names and add the dedicated Slack channel; share pager schedule by 11/24. Deliverable: support_runbook_draft.md (Grace).
5) QBR: I will draft a one-slide summary of readiness and three risks for execs. Please drop projected token consumption and estimated pilot spend into the shared QBR slides (hubspot:deals/457) by 11/23.

Katrina — are there any procurement blockers on your side from the procurement thread? If yes, please paste the key ask here so we can escalate.

I'll merge updated artifacts into the readiness matrix after you all push changes and will circulate the QBR one-pager on 11/22 for review.

Monica
Senior Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: readiness_matrix_v1.xlsx, pricing_table_vF.docx, enablement_playbook.pdf, support_runbook_draft.md
